meeting_summary: Alex and Participant 1 reviewed the status of a client dashboard update ahead of a Friday send. They agreed on specific wording fixes to the usage/renewal section and summary slide, confirmed the benchmark comparison would be left out, and aligned on a same-day delivery plan with a clear handoff workflow before the Tuesday client meeting.

key_topics.summary: The deck is in good shape overall — numbers are clean, formatting is improved, and the recommendation page reads better than it did two days ago.
The March dip in the usage/renewal section was flagged as dropping bad news abruptly; agreed to add a note under the chart to explain what happened more directly rather than restructure the slide.

The summary slide was identified as needing one more pass. The first bullet using the word 'mixed' was identified as vague and unhelpful; agreed to replace it with specific statements: engagement was up, retention was flat, and support tickets increased (note: 'support tickets increased' is an interpretation of garbled audio in the transcript).

key_topics.topic: Send timing decision — today vs. Monday
key_topics.summary: Both speakers agreed to send the dashboard to the client today so they have time to review it before the Tuesday meeting, rather than waiting until Monday.
Decided to leave out the benchmark comparison that had been discussed last week, as it would not change the recommendation and adding another chart at this stage felt unnecessary.

key_topics.topic: Support ticket increase framing in the deck
key_topics.summary: Agreed not to attribute the support ticket increase to onboarding changes in the deck since the cause is not confirmed; instead, acknowledge the increase without over-committing on the cause and discuss it in the Tuesday meeting.
Participant 1 declined Alex's offer to draft the client email, preferring to handle it personally so tone can be adjusted based on earlier correspondence.
